resources.scope: Execution interval only. Discrete samples, not continuous hardware peaks. rss includes worker descendants; own_gpu_memory is the supervisor-selected worker PID only. Card CSV is index,uuid,name,freeMiB,totalMiB,utilization. artifact_bytes measures the entire shared run tree and must not be summed across lines.

resident_calls.scope: Saved resident calls only; Only status400 with error.code=context_length_exceeded and no output is a local context rejection, not remote service downtime. interpretation.learning_claim: At most one actor/critic update and two different post-update development cases establish an executable bridge only; no matched learning-effect estimate.
